product_metadata.title: Korlon Ice Trays for Freezer with Lid and Bin, 64 PCS Ice Cube Trays, Round Ice Cube Molds & Square Container for Making Cocktail Whiskey Tea & Coffee
features: Two Shapes Design: This ice trays for freezer has a unique shape. Ice cube trays combine a sphere and a square into one. Each ice tray has 32 lattices, half square and half spherical. The two ice trays have 64 ice making lattices in total, so that you can make enough ice cubes of two different shapes each time you make.
Good Material: Our round ice cube molds are made of pp. So the ice cube trays are safe and durable, and easy to demould.

Removable Lid and Stackable: This ice cube tray with lid comes with its own ice storage box. The transparent ice storage box can see the capacity of ice without opening, bringing better visual experience. Stackable ice trays for freezer are super convenient and space saving. The removable lid helps prevent the ice from absorbing the smell in the refrigerator.
Easy to Use: Our round ice cube molds are very simple and convenient to operate. Just pour your favorite drink into the ice cube tray, cover it, and wait a few hours to get the ice cube.
Wide Use: Ice cubes made from ice cube tray with lid is very suitable for cocktail, whisky, coffee, tea, juice and other drinks. The ice cubes can also be used for freezing fruits and foods.
